errors.text_span: Оста X е линейна скала, означена като „години“. Диапазонът на стойностите е от 2013 до 2022 г. Етикетите са разположени равномерно през една година, като се показват стойностите 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021 и 2022 г.
errors.evidence: The x-axis is not labeled and has no visible ticks or values. The entire description of the x-axis, including its label, range, and specific year values, is hallucinated.
The y-axis is not labeled. The description incorrectly uses the chart's title, "НИРД като % от БВП", as the y-axis label.
The blue line does not have any markers.
The x-axis does not show any years. All references to specific years in the data description (e.g., 2013, 2018, 2022) are hallucinated.
The blue line starts at a value visibly below 1.9, approximately 1.83. The stated value of 1.92 is inaccurate.
The orange line does not have any markers.

The description incorrectly identifies the orange line for Bulgaria as a dotted line ("пунктирана линия"). The chart shows a solid orange line representing the primary data, and a separate dotted orange line representing a trend.

The description fails to mention that each category (EU and Bulgaria) is represented by two lines: a solid line for the actual data and a dotted line for the trendline. This omission leads to other errors, such as misidentifying the style of the orange line.
